name: Fluid Particle Mechanics
description: Introduction to fluid-particle system, fluid-particle dynamics, rigid spherical particle motion at low Reynolds number in uniform flow, rotational flow, simple-shear flow, motion of particles at finite Reynolds number, motion of non-spherical particles, motion of bubbles/droplets, motion of particles in non-dilute suspensions, batch and continuous settling (hindered settling), critically, underloaded and overloaded thickener, design principles for thickener, pressure drop across a packed bed, Blaine's apparatus, design principles for packed bed (packing, diameter and internals), fluidization, height of a fluidized bed, bubbling fluidization, filtration, centrifugal filtration, cyclone separator, dryer, mixing and segregation, particle size reduction, particle size enlargement.
